channel.title: Nubenetes Intelligence Digest
channel.description: AI-curated top picks from the Cloud Native & Kubernetes ecosystem

item.title: antigravity.google: Google Antigravity Agentic Platform
item.description: [CRITICAL] It provides a unified enterprise SDK and runtime to transition stateful AI agents from local prototypes to production-ready deployments on Google Kubernetes Engine.

item.title: NVIDIA/k8s-device-plugin: NVIDIA device plugin for Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the foundational hardware plugin enabling GPU task scheduling and acceleration across modern AI/ML workloads on Kubernetes.

item.title: ==Azure/azure-workload-identity==
item.description: [CRITICAL] Provides the enterprise standard for credential-less, zero-trust authentication between Kubernetes workloads and Azure cloud resources via OIDC federation.

item.title: Crossplane
item.description: [CRITICAL] Represents a major paradigm shift by transforming Kubernetes clusters into universal infrastructure control planes for multi-cloud management.

item.title: vLLM on Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] It standardizes production-grade, memory-efficient LLM serving on Kubernetes using PagedAttention, directly bridging foundation models with cloud-native infrastructure.

item.title: ==dagger/dagger: Dagger is a portable devkit for CICD==
item.description: [CRITICAL] Dagger introduces a major paradigm shift to CI/CD by replacing brittle YAML with portable, containerized pipelines written in general-purpose languages.

item.title: github.com: Istio
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the industry standard open-source service mesh control plane powering zero-trust mTLS and dynamic traffic routing.

item.title: github.com/kubernetes: **Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler**
item.description: [CRITICAL] Remains the ubiquitous, production-proven standard for dynamic node provisioning and elasticity across enterprise Kubernetes environments.

item.title: github: Flux Version 2
item.description: [CRITICAL] Flux v2 delivers a modular, controller-driven GitOps Toolkit that defines how modern enterprise clusters reconcile infrastructure and application state.

item.title: github.com/prometheus/prometheus
item.description: [CRITICAL] The foundational CNCF-graduated telemetry engine that defines the standard for monitoring, scraping, and alerting across cloud-native environments.

item.title: github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-operator
item.description: [CRITICAL] Crucial Kubernetes operator that automates OpenTelemetry collector lifecycles and streamlines application auto-instrumentation at scale.

item.title: containerd - An open and reliable container runtime
item.description: [CRITICAL] It is the foundational CNCF-graduated container runtime powering modern Kubernetes clusters and production container workloads.

item.title: runc
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the canonical OCI reference low-level container runtime executing Linux cgroups and namespace isolation.

item.title: ==github.com/Netflix/metaflow== 🌟
item.description: [CRITICAL] Metaflow provides an enterprise-proven, human-centric framework that bridges local data science experimentation with scalable Kubernetes orchestration.

item.title: hashicorp/vault
item.description: [CRITICAL] Remains the foundational enterprise secret manager and dynamic workload identity broker underpinning Zero Trust cloud-native architectures.

item.title: OpenTelemetry Collector
item.description: [CRITICAL] Serves as the ubiquitous, vendor-agnostic industry standard pipeline for ingesting, processing, and exporting traces, metrics, and logs.

item.title: Kubernetes Gateway API
item.description: [CRITICAL] Defines the official next-generation specification superseding Ingress with role-oriented, expressive service routing APIs.

item.title: github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero
item.description: [CRITICAL] It serves as the de facto open-source standard for backing up, migrating, and disaster-recovering Kubernetes cluster state and persistent volumes.

item.title: trivy
item.description: [CRITICAL] The de facto comprehensive vulnerability, misconfiguration, and SBOM scanner across modern container pipelines and registries.

item.title: Announcing Claude Managed Agents on Cloudflare
item.description: [CRITICAL] It establishes an enterprise-grade, sandboxed serverless execution plane on edge infrastructure for running autonomous AI agents securely at scale.
